title: Open Data & Datasets
tagline: Statistics, geospatial, humanitarian, and historical data
description: National statistics, civic open data, humanitarian datasets, and geospatial layers covering Nepal. Many sources offer CKAN APIs, raw CSV/Shapefile downloads, or programmatic search.

resources.name: Open Data Nepal
resources.description: CKAN-based civic open-data portal run by Open Knowledge Nepal. Relaunched 2025 on CKAN 2.11.3 with refreshed UX.

resources.name: NSO Nepal Data Portal
resources.description: Official statistics — Census 2021, NLFS, National Accounts, GDP. Bilingual (en/np). CKAN API available.

resources.name: HumData Exchange — Nepal
resources.description: 323+ humanitarian datasets from 62 orgs: COD-AB admin boundaries (Oct 2024), DHS, Meta High-Resolution Population Density, settlements, road network. CKAN API + HAPI.

resources.name: Nepal in Data
resources.description: Bikas Udhyami project. Data 1950–present across 13 themes; visualizations and downloads.

resources.name: ICIMOD Regional Database
resources.description: Hindu Kush Himalaya data: glacier mass balance, biomass, geology, climate. GeoNetwork API.

resources.name: ICIMOD Mountain Geoportal
resources.description: Geospatial data viewer for the HKH region.

resources.name: SERVIR-HKH
resources.description: NASA-USAID + ICIMOD remote-sensing platform for the HKH region.

resources.name: World Bank Nepal
resources.description: World Development Indicators for Nepal — accessible via the World Bank Indicators API.

resources.name: Open Knowledge Nepal — GitHub
resources.description: 43 repos: ckanext-odn, publicbodies-data, Local Boundaries geodata, ODAP, Nepal Digital Safety Corpus.

resources.name: Nepali Datasets — IOST/ASCOL
resources.description: Curated index of Nepali datasets by IOST/ASCOL.

resources.name: Nepali Datasets — pemagrg1
resources.description: Long-running curated list of Nepali NLP and general datasets.

resources.name: ML Datasets — amitness
resources.description: Amit Chaudhary's curated index of Nepali machine learning datasets.
